facts.fact: Devan splits the ten Kettamala men who came in at the raid (F545): four ride out with him, six stay at the Resin House, Bhaskaran among the six.

Neela tells Devan she will vouch for the forty as the Resin House under her own name; Devan answers that a vouched house has a master and the crown will write her name beside forty. Neela accepts that cost.
Neela's elder-sister contract (the third) involved two coast-house sisters; the elder kept bees. Twenty-two's intake name has four syllables.
